exposure: early oral feeding after 6 hours post-cesarean delivery
delayed oral feeding after 12 hours post-cesarean delivery
outcome: time to first passage of flatus
cohort: 140 term pregnant women who underwent uncomplicated cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Early oral feeding after cesarean delivery significantly reduced the time to first flatus and defecation and increased patient satisfaction, but also led to a higher incidence of nausea and vomiting.
followup_time: Up to 55 hours post-cesarean delivery for first defecation.
